techniques.name: Dreamer-CDP
techniques.capability_enabled: Reconstruction-free model-based RL: a JEPA-style predictor over continuous, deterministic latent representations predicts the next abstract state instead of reconstructing pixels, matching Dreamer's performance on Crafter without any reconstruction objective.
techniques.code_evidence: https://github.com/fmi-basel/Dreamer-CDP (official repo; 'The official code is available at github.com/fmi-basel/Dreamer-CDP', tested on Linux, Python 3.11+)
techniques.verbatim_quote: Dreamer-CDP: Improving Reconstruction-free World Models Via Continuous Deterministic Representation Prediction

techniques.name: ProRL Agent (Rollout-as-a-Service)
techniques.capability_enabled: Scalable multi-turn agentic RL training infrastructure that decouples the full rollout lifecycle (init/run/evaluate) from the GPU trainer via an HTTP rollout-as-a-service API, enabling rollout and training to run on separate machines with standardized sandbox environments.
techniques.code_evidence: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/ProRL-Agent-Server (official NVIDIA repo; 'ProRL Agent is open-sourced and integrated as part of NVIDIA NeMo Gym', also github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym)
techniques.verbatim_quote: ProRL Agent: Rollout-as-a-Service for RL Training of Multi-Turn LLM Agents

techniques.name: DART (Disentangled Action Reasoning Tuning)
techniques.capability_enabled: Resolves gradient interference between reasoning and tool-use in agentic RL by routing reasoning vs. tool-use tokens to disjoint LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone, so updates for the two capabilities never collide.
techniques.code_evidence: https://github.com/sheriyuo/DART (NOTE: described in results as an UNOFFICIAL/community implementation, not an author release; includes vocab fine-tuning, SFT and LoRA configs via ms-swift)
techniques.verbatim_quote: Reasoning and Tool-use Compete in Agentic RL: From Quantifying Interference to Disentangled Tuning

techniques.name: WorldCompass
techniques.capability_enabled: RL post-training framework for long-horizon interactive video world models, using a clip-level rollout strategy, complementary interaction-accuracy + visual-quality rewards, and negative-aware fine-tuning to improve interaction accuracy and visual fidelity over the open WorldPlay model.
techniques.code_evidence: No code/repo found in search results; only arXiv/HF paper pages returned, no github link or release statement.
techniques.verbatim_quote: WorldCompass: Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon World Models

techniques.name: World-Gymnast
techniques.capability_enabled: RL finetuning of a vision-language-action (VLA) policy by rolling out the policy inside an action-conditioned video world model and scoring rollouts with a VLM-based reward, outperforming SFT by up to 18x and a software simulator by up to 2x on the Bridge robot setup.
techniques.code_evidence: Project page exists (https://world-gymnast.github.io/) but search results returned NO github code repository link; project page alone, no released code/weights confirmed.
techniques.verbatim_quote: World-Gymnast: Training Robots with Reinforcement Learning in a World Model

techniques.name: AWPO (Advantage-Weighted Policy Optimization)
techniques.capability_enabled: Integrates chain-of-thought reasoning-quality rewards into RLVR advantage estimation for tool-use via variance-aware gating and difficulty-aware weighting, with a 4B model reportedly surpassing Grok-4 by 16.0% in multi-turn tool-use accuracy.
techniques.code_evidence: No code evidence in results; arXiv/HF/alphaXiv paper pages only, no github repo or release statement found across two targeted searches.
techniques.verbatim_quote: AWPO: Enhancing Tool-Use of Large Language Models through Adaptive Integration of Reasoning Rewards
